hints.title: The first preorder value is the root
hints.body: The next values form the left subtree until the root appears in the inorder traversal.

hints.title: Split by the root
hints.body: The root's position in inorder separates the left and right subtree values.

hints.title: Consume preorder in order
hints.body: Build nodes from preorder while tracking how much of inorder has been completed.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
root = new node(preorder[0])
stack = [root]
inIndex = 0
for value in preorder[1:]:
    node = new node(value)
    if stack.top.value != inorder[inIndex]:
        stack.top.left = node
    else:
        while stack and stack.top.value == inorder[inIndex]:
            last = stack.pop(); inIndex += 1
        last.right = node
    stack.push(node)
return root
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
